A row nested directly inside a cell keeps its visible text

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><tr><td><tr><td>Visible text</td></tr></td></tr></table>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
